title: Delivery notice — verify address

left.subject: Office delivery — confirm drop-off time
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Kian,

Your office package arrives tomorrow. If time changes, go to the Logistics portal and update your slot.

right.subject: Package held — pay small fee to release
right.bodyHtml: Action needed to release your package. Please confirm address and pay fee now.

explainPoints: Personal email target instead of your corporate address.
Requests payment via a link. Legit deliveries are handled by the Logistics portal or official courier apps.
Classic 'held package' lure designed to capture card details.
